deviations.title: Two-stage Lock 2
deviations.what: Coordinator's decision (20 Nov 01:53 EST). Stage 1: LOCK_A10_2 (03:41:21 EST, sha256 02048a431e41c6310202328545ac8d91e71f5c1bba78c3906fc0a672c6c5a4df) after FREEZE_CD (core, 139 files, sha256 4d345a4c3f0ce999ec36236bafc4156e0ad0e226c2b9432a6f3d8343b11c1ee7). Stage 2: LOCK_A10_2c of record (06:03:04 EST, sha256 94e06ed6b93a189c234911906896dc65d29f906aea17797e4622e844b211c0a6) after FREEZE_CD_2 (A10 sec. 5.7 additions, 99 files, sha256 1039025ce46a9de60163f4468535b227ca0ec3e8d2705af293bfbaa54797a8a0). Between the locks only the frozen core extractor ran (logs, CV0/B1 arrays) and no value was computed.
deviations.effect: None on values: every program that computes a value is in one of the two freezes and ran after the lock that gates it.

deviations.title: FREEZE_CD_add1: REPLACEMENTS_C_v13.json format
deviations.what: The file was written as a list; the frozen loader reads a mapping. It stopped the first extractor call while building the run list, before any fresh file was opened. Corrected to {} (same meaning: no replacement) and recorded in locks/FREEZE_CD_add1.json (sha256 0e562f346cdd64feaed605041565d44b3d6f2f2a8639d33ff955a33fadb2730f; file sha256 before 082081f7...59e9, after 05e26a6d...e58b). Accepted by the coordinator at 03:58 EST.

deviations.title: B7 on both families
deviations.what: B7 (tracker re-runs at every rate x latency) is scored on lead braking and on cut-in (coordinator 03:35 EST); the cut-in keys are B7CI.* (A accepted the names; C now has 364 keys).

deviations.title: B7 pod acceptance rule
deviations.what: The planned acceptance (pod arrays bit-identical to the laptop on old run 0037 in every key) failed in two keys B7 never reads (cA1, cQ; last bit, <= 4.2e-16 relative; Linux maths library). Amended rule (06:30 EST, coordinator): bit-identical on every key B7 reads; all other array keys within A10 B0(b)'s 1e-12; plus a value-identity gate: both frozen B7 programs give bit-identical outputs on pod and laptop 0037 arrays (76/76 values each).
deviations.effect: See CD-5: the 0037 gate did not cover runs with actor yaw.

deviations.title: Six cut-in runs re-extracted on the laptop for B7
deviations.what: The cut-in recount refused run 0184 because the pod-made arrays differed from the laptop CV0 at the last bit in keys B7 reads (glibc on the pod vs Windows libm in the extraction geometry; exact_trig covers only the tracker path; the straight-road 0037 had not shown it). A survey of all fresh runs found 6 such runs: pc13_c1109_eval_0114, 0184, 0226, 0238, 0358, 0418 (all _native). Coordinator's rule (08:45 EST): such runs are re-extracted on the laptop with the frozen extractor (all 8 chains, 48 files) and replace the pod files; each run's laptop 2/0 chain equals CV0 on all 45 keys. Both B7 analyses and both recounts were re-run on the corrected arrays.
deviations.effect: B7/B7CI values are those of laptop-equivalent arrays; first and second programs agree on all values.

deviations.title: D2 reaction-and-stop column scored to the end of the stop
deviations.what: A10 sec. 1 judges reaction-and-stop plans until the stop ends (v11 rev_e1 extended clearance, clearX, shared through arrays/RSX). The frozen core D2 programs score a 61-frame horizon. The reaction-and-stop column of D2 is therefore taken from the stage-2 programs analysis/d2_rs_v13.py (first) and recount_d/rc_d2_rs_v13.py (second); the 61-frame react_stop column of the core recount is not exported. Identity check: the minimum distance equals clearX on all 3,434 fresh pairs.
deviations.effect: D2.*.rs keys come from the stage-2 programs.

deviations.title: FREEZE_CD_add2: a frozen identity check refused a legitimate NaN
deviations.what: The core cut-in import stopped (20 Nov about 23:40 EST, no output) at analysis/cd_common_v13.py:333, which compares the recomputed full-sample values with the calibration job's by np.array_equal without equal_nan. On the fresh runs the cut-in event window has no room, so its full-sample values are R_gl = 0.0 and RR_N = NaN (undefined), and NaN never equalled NaN. The frozen merge tool, pod runner and recount import already compare with NaN equal to NaN. Fix, approved by the coordinator (about 23:45 EST): that line only gets equal_nan=True; the check stays exact. Recorded in locks/FREEZE_CD_add2.json (sha256 df4e03c9a00df30f7b0159f8585df911a4b202745817241854462030f4d46d02; file sha256 before 978dc19c...cf0c2, after 28a7238a...bdd0).
deviations.effect: No analysis change. With no NaN the check gives the same result, so the lead import (which passed it) is unaffected.

deviations.title: FREEZE_CD_2_add1: the exporter reads B's flat export
deviations.what: The first call of the frozen exporter on fresh runs (21 Nov about 01:00 EST) stopped with KeyError: 'values' and wrote nothing: TRANSFER.structured read package B's A_EXPORT_B.json / A_RECOUNT_B.json as {'values': {...}}, but B's exports are flat {key: value}, a layout A's loader accepts (A_text/gen/common_v13.py load_export). Fix, approved by the coordinator (about 00:20 EST): make_export_cd_v13.py lines 285 (B) and 304 (F) read the 'values' dict if present, else the flat file; no other change. Recorded in locks/FREEZE_CD_2_add1.json (sha256 e4e311049433f80a6f7a29cbe89543d95aceaa2377163c85fe8cdeded0b74161; file sha256 before 99fb107d...dfc2, after ab4e5b92...0484).
deviations.effect: No value is computed differently; TRANSFER.structured gets B's tuning set (TU.RR_*).

deviations.title: FREEZE_CD_2_add2: two exporter lines (B7CI keys; the recount's old-run TG)
deviations.what: Found in the first fresh exports (21 Nov about 00:25-00:50 EST). (1) make_export_cd_v13.py line 366 kept C keys whose first dot-part is LB, CI, TU, B, B7, TRANSFER or HAND; 'B7CI' (A's names accepted 20 Nov 03:35) was missing, so the 32 B7CI.* supplement keys were dropped although both family files carry them. (2) Line 298 read the recount's old-run TG for TRANSFER.structured as point.descriptive.TG.RR, while the recount's old-run file stores RR_gl (0.3212018942899134, equal to the first program's value), so the second export had old-run TG = null (its TRANSFER outcome was nevertheless identical). Fix, approved by the coordinator (01:05 and 01:15 EST): 'B7CI' added to the tuple; .get('RR') -> .get('RR_gl'); nothing else. Recorded in locks/FREEZE_CD_2_add2.json (sha256 1e8f131d6b992e5e47efb5b8ef170f95cd41c755353046cd84da3e2b4c9114e2; file sha256 before ab4e5b92...0484 (after add1), after 16b84f81...0940). The frozen make_freeze_cd_v13.py --verify does not chain two addenda on one file; tools/verify_chain_cd_v13.py checks the chain (FREEZE_CD 139/139, FREEZE_CD_2 99/99, no break).
deviations.effect: No value is computed differently; the B7CI.* keys reach the C exports and the recount's TRANSFER.structured has its old-run TG.

deviations.title: FREEZE_CD_2_add3: the second exporter reads the D2 recount's 3 s column
deviations.what: A_RECOUNT_D lacked the 16 keys D2.{F0,N,CK3,TG}.{c2,c5}.w3.{runs,vclose} although the frozen D2 recount (recount_d/rc_d2_event_table_v13.py, RC_D2_EVENT_TABLE_v13.json) computed them and the sec. 10.1(c) comparison out/COMPARE_D_v13.json (185/185) had already compared them with the first program (all equal): make_export_cd_v13.py line 262 looked up table['commit_3s'], but the recount nests table[source][scoring][target], so the column was skipped silently. Fix, approved by the coordinator (about 01:20 EST) in place of a new second program: line 262 only. Recorded in locks/FREEZE_CD_2_add3.json (sha256 dc48da9fe515eb05a93f51aca51cab6e8ec6fa8223b59927990ef72a59c72b3b; file sha256 before 16b84f81...0940 (after add2), after ec1fbc45...ff77). Chain checked by tools/verify_chain_cd_v13.py.
deviations.effect: No value is computed differently; the 16 keys reach A_RECOUNT_D from the frozen independent recount.

deviations.title: Calibration computed in chunks on pods
deviations.what: The A10 sec. 2.6 double bootstrap (2,000 outer x 1,000 inner; inner seeds 20261913/20261914) ran as chunks of outer replicates on RunPod CPU workers and was merged by tools/calib_merge_v13.py, which checks that the chunks tile 0..2000 exactly and that every chunk reproduced the full-sample statistics. On old runs the chunked path equals the in-process path (recount/test_rc_calib_chunks_v13.py; analysis/out/calib_testold).

deviations.title: Undefined values
deviations.what: An undefined interval or value is written as null (never [null, null], never NaN), per A. CI.Y.R.dec = 0 when the young-track population is empty (K2's rule; both S57A programs).

deviations.title: Run storage and salvage (before any value)
deviations.what: After the volume quota was reached, C archives went to pod disks and the laptop; 12 runs whose capture and reviews had passed were salvaged from complete local archives (receipts marked 'salvaged'); A10 sec. 5.1's retry rule was not invoked for them. The 57 rs13 re-simulation archives (old runs re-simulated frame-identically; regenerable) are kept only on the network volume, SHA-256-checked (resim_on_volume_v01.json).

deviations.title: Definitions fixed before any fresh value
deviations.what: D1 reserves (5 per variant, cases 55-59, continuing default_rng(20261921); none needed) and 3 non-study pilots; cut-in threshold 1.75 m (B9); H4 like-for-like single scale; K0's den0 = the perfect oracle's gridless room in decision-equivalents; K2's E5_N; D2 operating points, first loss of clearance and closing speed. Wording: STATUS.md, 'Decisions and departures'.

status_keys_added.rule: A's status keys and flags (RESULTS_INTERFACE_v13 sec. 2; names agreed with A 21 Nov), A's vocabulary, from this program's own outputs; A10 sec. 9 applied (not_run after a failed K0); first and second identical (checked)
